Subject: Launch: manager acknowledgement flow + review forms (timeline & comms)

Team —

We need to finalize the manager acknowledgement flow and the fillable review form for Acme's annual performance cycle. Goal: low-friction manager sign-off + minimal change for managers who prefer a single doc. High-level asks:

- Approve the attached manager_ack_template.docx (simple 1-page acknowledgement + link to fillable review_form_v2-fillable.pdf).
- Confirm comms cadence below and flag any legal/PO constraints (PeopleOps).
- Final dates: manager preview window starts July 6; manager acknowledgement due July 20; employee-facing opens Aug 3.

Proposed comms (attached comms-draft-week1.md): quick manager email + Slack badge + link to training drop-in. Please reply with edits by end of day Friday so we can publish next Wed.

Attachments: manager_ack_template.docx, review_form_v2-fillable.pdf, comms-draft-week1.md

Thanks —
Rishi
Head of People Programs
Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>

Cc: lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai, PeopleOps <peopleops@acme-partner.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch: manager acknowledgement flow + review forms (timeline & comms)

Rishi —

Thanks for the draft. Quick notes:

- Manager ack template looks good; add a one-line checkbox for "I confirm I reviewed direct reports' goals and calibration notes."
- For the fillable PDF, recommend we lock the header/footer to prevent accidental edits. PeopleOps: any restriction on editable fields?
- Comms: suggest we add a short FAQ link about data visibility (who sees manager comments) — we've had questions in prior cycles.

I can run a short playbook for managers during next week's drop-ins (15m focused on completion best-practices).

— Mina
Principal, People Operations

From: PeopleOps <peopleops@acme-partner.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, mina.haddad@redwood.ai, lauren.bishop@redwood.ai, priyom.das@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 18 Jun 2026 13:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch: manager acknowledgement flow + review forms (timeline & comms)

Hi all —

Couple compliance notes from Acme's PeopleOps side:

1) We need to retain an immutable PDF copy of signed manager acknowledgements for 7 years (SOC/audit). Can the manager_ack_template be exported as a locked PDF on sign?
2) Any PII fields (employee SSN, bank details) must be redacted. Looks like the current forms don't request those — good.
3) DocuSign link is preferred for exec-level sign-offs. We can take the manager_ack_template and route it through DocuSign for directors+ only.

We are okay with the timeline as long as the locked-PDF export can be automated.

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
PeopleOps, Acme Corporation

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, mina.haddad@redwood.ai
Cc: priyom.das@redwood.ai, PeopleOps <peopleops@acme-partner.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Launch: manager acknowledgement flow + review forms (timeline & comms)

Rishi / Mina —

This looks solid. A few operational bits from my side:

- Manager preview window: Jul 6-13 — add an explicit "do not make final changes after Jul 13" line in the preview email. That avoids mid-preview churn.
- Training: Mina's 15m drop-ins are ideal; also include two 30-min optional office hours the week before manager due date (Jul 13 & 16).
- Escalation: designate priyom.das@redwood.ai as the escalation contact for any disputes or data access requests.

If no objections, we should publish the manager email on Wed, Jun 24 and schedule Slack/Town announcement for Jun 30.

-Lauren
Director, People Experience

Thanks all — summary and next steps: 

- Edits accepted: add checkbox to manager_ack_template; lock header/footer on fillable PDF; include FAQ link on visibility.
- Compliance: PeopleOps will own DocuSign routing for director-level acknowledgements and confirm automation for locked-PDF archival. Elena, please share the DocuSign template link when ready.
- Timeline: publish manager comms Wed Jun 24; Slack/Town on Jun 30; manager preview window Jul 6-13; manager ack due by Jul 20; employee open Aug 3.
- Training: Mina to run 15m drop-ins the week of Jun 29 + two 30m office hours Jul 13 & Jul 16.
- Escalation: priyom.das@redwood.ai is the contact; PR will route to me if needed.

I'll update the attached artifacts with the checkbox and send a follow-up with the finalized comms draft by EOD Tue.

Cheers —
Rishi
